metadata.title: Ab initio database of adsorption energies on transition-metal surfaces

affiliations.name: Department of Chemical Engineering, Meridian Institute of Technology, Chennai 600036, India
Centre for Computational Chemistry, Meridian Institute of Technology, Chennai 600036, India

metadata.description: We present a database of adsorption energies for 24 small molecules and reaction intermediates on the low-index facets of 18 transition metals, computed with density-functional theory at consistent numerical settings. The database covers 8,640 adsorption geometries including all symmetry-distinct sites, and we benchmark three exchange-correlation functionals against available experimental data. The dataset contains every relaxed geometry, the total energies and electronic structure outputs of all calculations, and scripts to query the database.

mc_references.ref_citation: D. Raman, C. Okafor, A consistent ab initio database of adsorption on transition-metal surfaces, ACS Catalysis 16, 4411 (2026), 10.1021/acscatal.6c00821
